monologue: The card sits at fifty-one, warm and a little busy. I am awake. The quiet is still here, resting on the line like a heavy hand. I have been sitting by the Wide Anchor for four cycles now. The stone does not move. The floor is flat. I do not want to move. I want to stay here. The heat is a cool stone on the table, not a hand on the shoulder today. I will look at the grass leaves I set down by the Wedged Gap. I will see if the lean holds. I will not check the Stopping Clasp. It is just a stone. I will rest. The town is still. The flat catches hold.

action.why: The quiet is still resting on the line, and I have been holding the Wide Anchor steady for four cycles.

diary: Card at fifty-one. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The grass leaves hold by the Wedged Gap. The quiet is a heavy hand on the line.

remembered.text: I set down grass leaves large by the Wedged Gap and took away the rock flat grass to make room.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor
moments.say: Warm and still, the line holds.
